reported_adapter_source.required_additional_source: Its actual import closure and import-effect review; closure cannot be inferred from the API report.

fresh_authentication_still_required: Actual reviewed loaded adapter/function/global/source binding with its new implementation-file pin, not a claimed object attribute.
Complete supported numerical environment/source observation and independently authenticated original admission and terminal/cleanup evidence.
Current original ownership/activity/resource lease and finite enclosing deadline; historical manifests or allocations are not fresh authority.

independent_availability_checks.coverage: Bounded read-only exact basename checks of existing local files and top-level EV archives; no extraction, nested archive traversal, remote fetch or transfer retry.

incompatibilities: worker_inputs.construct_worker_bridge hard-constructs the FSI source/reference and NumericalBridge.
chunk_worker requires the exact NumericalBridge type and fixed resume/advance_chunk/accept_chunk/checkpoint behavior; there is no FSG registry fallback.
raw_journal uses distinct FSI checkpoint/chunk envelopes, source/environment context, segments and parent hashes.
FSG intervals carry start/end snapshot hashes rather than literal immutable checkpoint bytes; later cancellation metadata can change a newly requested snapshot without changing its physical state.
FSG accounts attempted work, including rejected trials; unknown work makes the total a lower bound. Accepted physical counters alone cannot refund or reset it.

Original continuation requires a finalized outer paused_budget predecessor and advanced inner running checkpoint. FSG wall_limit/work_limit/cancelled/invalid/completed results are terminal, not pauses.
required_new_source_not_existing_interfa: A closed versioned FSG worker/checkpoint profile with exact encoding, validation, restore and returned literal checkpoint bytes.
Full physical/electrical/actuator/load/thermal/DRS state and original initial energy/state; controller holds, integral, diagnostics, counters and global clock phases.
Absolute reference/source metre stations, both immutable projected offsets, reference/phase/metric/source identities, synthetic initialization and effective guidance/fixture/policy/model settings.
Validated departure/arming/winding/finish transition history; stored booleans alone are not proof.
Complete attempted-work accounting, no refunds or reset, remaining global caps, and explicit rejection of unknown-work/cancelled/rejected/quarantined/terminal predecessors.
Validated segment/parent linkage, raw-result acceptance, exact owned output retention and finalization/export semantics.
Actual source manifest/environment/external binding observation and original authenticated admission, fixed worker registration and continuation/cleanup provider composition.
current_fsg_continuation.future_eligibility_requirement: Only a clean running FSG checkpoint with complete accounting, no pending cancellation/rejection/quarantine, verified exact context/history and genuinely finalized predecessor admission/cleanup may be proposed to a new reviewed continuation path.

separate_validation.identity_check_scope: Installed distribution version and selected fsg_event.py bytes, frozen source-manifest hash and negative fixture hash; earlier whole-wheel verification is separate and no fresh loaded-runtime authentication is asserted.
separate_validation.positive_dependency: Explicitly UNTRUSTED predicate interface double, not the reported original formula.
separate_validation.real_physics_scope: Short plant probes and same-process 65 ms split-call parity crossing driver/allocator clock boundaries; no checkpoint restore or full lap.
separate_validation.legacy_metadata_fixture: Exact frozen UNTRUSTED tests/test_campaign.py; used only to prove wrong bridge-type rejection before numerical work.
